from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from collections import defaultdict
import hashlib,json
import pandas as pd
P=Path.cwd();R=P/'reports/research/510300_electricity_component_state_description_v1'
if (R/'同原周期去重与嵌套段落澄清.json').exists():raise RuntimeError('澄清已保存，不重复')
source=P/'reports/research/510300_electricity_original_publication_state_v1/全部实际原统计区间.json'
raw=json.loads(source.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
groups=defaultdict(list)
for i,x in enumerate(raw):groups[(x['source_url'],x['stat_period_start'],x['stat_period_end'])].append((i,x))
unique=[];duplicate=[]
for key,xs in groups.items():
 encoded={json.dumps({'kind':x['period_kind'],'measures':x['measures'],'publication_date':x['publication_date']},ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True) for _,x in xs}
 if len(encoded)!=1:raise RuntimeError('同原周期有值冲突，不能去重')
 unique.append(xs[0][0])
 if len(xs)>1:
  duplicate.append({'source_url':key[0],'stat_start':key[1],'stat_end':key[2],'raw_extraction_indices':[i for i,_ in xs],'duplicate_rows':len(xs)-1,'reason':'原HTML外层p和嵌套内层p都含同字段，被原段落解析分别保存；显示量/同比/日期完全相同，不是多次独立发布','original_measures_identical':True})
table=pd.read_parquet(R/'全部99原周期_四组状态与显示值近似构成.parquet')
u=table.iloc[unique].copy()
u.to_csv(R/'同原95唯一周期_原提取99行全部保留.csv',index=False,encoding='utf-8-sig')
stats=[]
for kind in ['SINGLE_MONTH','CUMULATIVE_INTERVAL','ANNUAL']:
 z=u[u.period_kind==kind]
 states=z.total_secondary_state.value_counts().to_dict()
 stats.append({'period_kind':kind,'unique_same_original_periods':len(z),'total_secondary_comparable':int((z.total_secondary_state!='UNKNOWN').sum()),'UNKNOWN':int((z.total_secondary_state=='UNKNOWN').sum()),'states':{k:int(v) for k,v in states.items()},'positive_total_rows_with_known_secondary':int(((z['全社会_原同比_pct']>0)&z['第二产业_原同比_pct'].notna()).sum()),'positive_total_secondary_nonpositive':int(((z['全社会_原同比_pct']>0)&(z['第二产业_原同比_pct']<=0)).sum())})
now=datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
note={'clarified_at':now,'original_raw_extraction_rows':99,'unique_same_source_stat_periods':len(unique),'exact_duplicate_extraction_rows':99-len(unique),'duplicate_groups':duplicate,'original_E41_file_sha256_unchanged':hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'E41_original_raw_99_records_and_51_announcement_states_preserved':True,'E41_model_source_gate_556_unknown_preserved':True,'all_original_E43_99_records_kept':True,'unique_period_summary':stats,'counterexample_month_unchanged':'2022-07','E42_indexed_extra_case_not_spliced':True,'not_strategy_parameter_or_sample_selection':True,'stocks_return_data_not_read':True,'new_models':0}
def save(n,v):(R/n).write_text(json.dumps(v,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
save('同原周期去重与嵌套段落澄清.json',note)
current=R/'result.json'
(R/'result_原99提取频数初稿.json').write_bytes(current.read_bytes())
result=json.loads(current.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
result.update({'original_rows_are_extraction_records_not_unique_periods':True,'unique_same_source_stat_periods':len(unique),'exact_duplicate_extraction_records':99-len(unique),'unique_periods':stats,'unique_count_clarification':'同原HTML嵌套p导致4完全重复提取，99原记录保留，唯一统计周期95；单月44/累计45/年度6。未改原字段/日期/源门/模型。'})
save('result.json',result)
report=R/'原用电四组异向与总量代理边界_历史发现.md'
s=report.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
s+=f"\n## 同原重复提取澄清\n\n原99是提取记录，并非99唯一原统计周期；4条来自原HTML外层p及嵌套p的完全相同字段重复。全部原记录/原E41源门保留，另列95唯一同原周期：{json.dumps(stats,ensure_ascii=False)}。原单月44期中43可比较：40期总量/二产均正、2期均负、1期总量正但二产负、1期产业同比未知。唯一反例仍为2022-07，不把它推广成所有月份或指数方向规律。E42不同索引转载2022-11额外案例不并入。\n"
report.write_text(s,encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps(note,ensure_ascii=False))
